subject: mixedmirt: "Error: Inf or NaN values appeared in the gradient"

messages.author: 87096be9e51acd2d
messages.subject: mixedmirt: "Error: Inf or NaN values appeared in the gradient"
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I am working with a likert-scale data with a number of covariates and with a model specified as:

model <- mirt.model('
                    F1 = 2,4,9,18
                    F2 = 3,7,10
                    F3 = 6,11,16
                    F4 = 1,8,13,15
                    F5 = 5,12,14,17,19
                    COV = F1*F2*F3*F4*F5
                      ')

I am trying to run mixedmirt function as such:

bdmod<- mixedmirt(likert, cov, model, itemtype="gpcm", 
                  fixed = ~0, random = ~ 1|school,
                  lr.fixed = ~ gender + course_tot + textbook + teacher_app,
                  technical = list(removeEmptyRows = TRUE))

After approx. 101 iterations this leads to an error message: Error: Inf or NaN values appeared in the gradient

Any help on where the problem lies? This model runs fine with itemtype "grsm". 



Tuomas

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mixedmirt: "Error: Inf or NaN values appeared in the gradient"
parts:
The "after 101 iterations" tells me that the inclusion of the random school intercept effect + combination of the lr fixed effects has caused issues in the sampling scheme. It's hard to say what exactly went wrong without seeing the data first hand, but I suspect this has to do with extreme parameters obtained during the M-step updates. IRT methods can be fragile given the categorical response natures of the data, so sometimes scaling can be problematic, as well as other issues such as slopes tending to ±∞. You could try different starting values to see if you have any luck there, but I can't guarantee this issue can be fixed. 

Phil
